critique: Flawless execution of the product details: exact 9 upper ticks with a clean blank lower arc, accurate typography on all 5 beach labels and lower sub-dial, single burnt-orange pointer hand per gauge, and a tactile matte off-white housing without any glass glare. The gravity-defying balance on the translucent honey onyx pyramid paired with cool-to-warm chiaroscuro lighting feels straight out of a late-70s Domus editorial.
